# Rev

> Rev is a comprehensive transcription, captioning, and AI-powered media processing platform serving legal, criminal justice, and digital content creators.

Rev provides professional transcription services, video captioning solutions, and AI-powered tools for converting audio and video content to text. The platform serves diverse industries including legal depositions, criminal justice, and digital media, with support for multiple audio/video formats and accessibility compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- Transcription services
- Video captioning
- AI transcription
- Legal technology
- Court reporting
- Audio-to-text conversion
- Closed captions
- Subtitles
- Digital evidence
- Speech-to-text API
- File format conversion
- Video accessibility
- WCAG/ADA compliance
- Deposition services
- Audio formats (MP3, WAV, M4A, MOV, etc.)
